questions.prompt: On a 1 : 50 000 map, 1 cm represents how many km?
On a 1 : 100 000 map, a road measures 4.5 cm. How long is the road in km?
questions.explanation: 1 cm represents 1 km, so 4.5 cm represents 4.5 km.

questions.prompt: "1 cm represents 2 km" written as a representative fraction is…

questions.explanation: The large-scale map (smallest denominator) shows a small area in more detail.

questions.prompt: What is the best way to measure a winding river on a map?

choices.text: a ruler straight from end to end
a piece of string laid along the river

questions.explanation: String follows the curves; then straighten it against the scale.
